text: This morning I was very encouraged by meeting the Gallik couple and visiting their Museum of Folk Culture in Lendak. A couple who were born in the village and lived there all their life, built a museum on their own property. They were concerned that the wooden houses in which generations of Lendak families were born and raised, would not disappear. They took care to preserve exceptional goral costumes, which remind ordinary and special days of the village life. Spouses keep memories of proud, hardworking and deeply believing families from Lendak, which I had the opportunity to get to know at least in this way. I am grateful to them and other civic associations in the region who take care of preserving the Goral culture, which is our common heritage.

They took great care to preserve the Goral people's unique costumes, which recall both ordinary and special days of village life. The couple cherishes the memories of the proud, hardworking, and deeply religious families of Lendak, whom I was fortunate to meet in this way. I am grateful to them and other community organizations in the region that are committed to preserving Goral culture, which is our shared heritage.

This morning, I was deeply inspired by meeting the Gallik family and visiting their Folk Culture Museum in Lendak. The couple, who were born in this village and have lived here their entire lives, built the museum on their property. text: Zelenskyy Invites Slovak PM Fico to Ukraine Amid ‘Druzhba’ Pipeline Dispute President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is holding a phone call with Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico and has invited him to Ukraine to “discuss all outstanding issues,” the Ukrainian Presidential Office reported. The call follows a statement by Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orbán, who announced an agreement with Fico to create a joint bilateral commission to inspect the Druzhba pipeline. Orbán called on Zelensky to grant Hungarian and Slovak inspectors access to damaged sections of the pipeline and reiterated the need to immediately resume Russian oil transit through Druzhba.
